purpose: PRM vendors whose public customer pages are harvested for the proxy-positive population (workstream B).
stratificationRule: Segment tier assigned from each vendor's own positioning and published pricing BEFORE any harvest ran, never from what the harvest returned. Kiflo and PartnerPortal.io price and position for SMB; Impartner, ZINFI and Zift sell enterprise. A Kiflo customer is a much closer Introw ICP proxy than a ZINFI customer, so results are reported per stratum and never pooled.
